actions.name: actions/github-script
actions.verification: Annotated v9.0.0 tag dereferenced through official GitHub Git-object API to the selected commit.

nativeIdentity.reason: Private durable closure ordering is stored separately; public observation context and protocol remain compatible.

archiveHandling.nativeSetup: Existing bounded manifest and payload format with byte-count and SHA-256 verification.
archiveHandling.packaging: Python standard-library zipfile and existing desktop/PowerShell archive paths. No unrelated Rust zip dependency introduced.

evidenceBoundaries: Public package/release metadata verifies freshness, not compatibility, speed or runtime acceptance.
No signing, physical sound, user browser enrollment or signed-in account success is inferred from dependency updates.
Keep exact artifact source/version/hash gates and independent Windows runtime checks unchanged.
Local cached Rust 1.99.0 and Chromium 158 checks are supplementary; hosted Rust 1.100.1 and Playwright 1.65.2 remain required.
Windows named-pipe tests must execute on Windows; a GNU cross-check alone is not runtime proof.
Dashboard triage and native closure work are measured on complete workloads; new functionality and durability costs are reported explicitly, without a speedup claim over missing guarantees.

boundedReuseReview.releaseCheckout: Reuse refreshed official Athena release_checkout.py with exact policy and source-bound closeout; no competing validator introduced.

browserRuntimeProof.review: Exact source inspected; its headless-page CDP subset is not established as equivalent to installed MV3, Electron, audio/offscreen or native-messaging acceptance.
browserRuntimeProof.decision: Retain Playwright Chromium/Electron/native runtime lanes and source-bound artifacts; keep the candidate as a documented bounded reuse option, without a speculative replacement or duplicate harness.

boundedReuseReview.drift: No required shared contract divergence or dependency hold introduced.

changedWorkflowModernization.actions: actions/checkout and actions/setup-node advance from v4 to current v7
changedWorkflowModernization.acceptance: Scoped pull_request plus reusable workflow_call; unified publication waits for both Linux/Windows recovery jobs. Concurrency is scoped by caller workflow and ref.
